preconditions.description: The number of words in the text is between 1 and 300, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each word consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
preconditions.description: All words in the text are composed of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: The length of text does not exceed 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total length of all words in the text, including spaces, does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: The output is an integer representing the minimum length of the text after at most one abbreviation.
postconditions.description: The output must be an integer that represents the shortest possible length of the text after performing an abbreviation, if possible.
